# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not report security problems in public issues or pull requests.

Report them privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/cs4-game/security/advisories/new).

Include:

- The affected version or commit
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept
- The impact you expect
